lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13 high-contrast white vertical stripes are visible on the primary subject. Spacing is widest at the mid-torso and becomes progressively denser towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 8th stripe from the shoulder, splitting at the dorsal terminus. A secondary partial bifurcation is observed on the 11th stripe near the upper haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed white segment observed between the 10th and 11th stripes. Several stripes, specifically the 3rd and 5th, terminate before reaching the ventral mass boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 distinct white spots is located on the upper haunch. One larger, high-contrast spot is situated lower on the hind limb near the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align in a near-vertical geometric orientation, approximately parallel to the 13th stripe.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white crescent-shaped band visible at the base of the neck. Three distinct white spots are located on the lateral facial region: two below the eye and one on the muzzle.
